What are some good not-so-common things to include in a résumé?

Volunteer work. It opens a great avenue of discussion if the employer/recruiter brings it up in an interview and you can show off work ethic! Also include a "career goals" line (2-4 sentences) to show your prospective employer that you have drive and plan on staying in the field for a while.

Cover Page. Very few people, at least in my experience, include a cover page directed to the specific position and company applying for. This helps your resume standout and not feel like a resume sent out en masse.
What's a good way to include membership in honor societies? And things like that?
Probably an articulate, specific career goal. The resume shows where you've been, but what about where you're going?
What skills did you take away from your previous jobs that you can put to use here? And more importantly: what did you achieve there which shows you're good material for this new one?
